name: VoiceOS
long_description:
VoiceOS turns voice into a seamless, universal interface to 10x productivity — a true voice operating system for the next era of computing.

It works across any app, letting users speak naturally to dictate, edit, and write text instantly. Whether writing an email, revising a document, or grasping complex information, VoiceOS transforms voice into the most powerful productivity tool, bridging the gap between thought and expression.
one_liner: Say it and it's done. Voice is the new OS

launches.title: VoiceOS: The Siri for Productivity
launches.tagline: VoiceOS is on a mission to turn your voice into 10X productivity across every app
launches.body:
Launch video: <https://youtu.be/QaVzPkH8JA0>

## **The problem:** Typing sucks

Most people use their keyboard **hundreds of times a day** and the costs adds up:

* **Mental overhead** turning thoughts into words
* Spending time **correcting** **your** **typos**
* **Lost momentum** when context-switching

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97653&key=user_uploads/1521900/9d0e1af6-686c-4738-959b-17b2155c6d88)

## **The solution:** Voice as the new **OS**

VoiceOS is a universal voice interface that converts **thoughts → polished output** instantly.

* **Reply instantly:** _“Ask to reschedule for tomorrow”_ → replied instantly
* **Better prompting:** Turn thoughts into perfect prompts effortlessly
* **Works everywhere:** Works with any app with zero setup required

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97653&key=user_uploads/1521900/f3639813-a12c-4f6f-9c88-c61b7429ae76)

## **The team: Voice AI Pioneers**

Kai, on the left, with Jonah on the right. Over the **past 7 years** they’ve built voice AI solutions, from consumer products to Fortune 500 deployments. They are now building a **voice operating system** built for a **world where** **AGI** is no longer science fiction but an emerging roadmap.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97653&key=user_uploads/1521900/98299fdf-31e1-4bc5-b7ce-f9a6633ab874)

## **Our ask**

Try it out for free! <https://voiceos.com>

Use discount code **YCLAUNCH**

— Kai & Jonah
